name: Toronto General game hospital
source_fact: Toronto General Hospital is at 200 Elizabeth Street, east of University Avenue just south of College Street. Its Elizabeth entrances are between College and Gerrard.
game_compression: The original existing Core facade at 512,320 represents a compressed hospital building. The University-side game forecourt and exit are fictional, not surveyed entrance coordinates. Existing roads, artwork and collision bytes remain unchanged.
evidence: Raw full-foot collision candidates are source checks only. Actual recovery, signed-bank tile allocation, scrolling/overlay behavior and hardware visuals need the distinct integrated ROM's native checks.
